rationale: The customer fixed the problem by cleaning the contacts, and the assistant correctly confirmed it and recommended no part. However, the first reply never clarified whether 'e5' was the model or an error code, and it gave generic charger advice that did not suit a robot vacuum dock. It did not tell the customer to unplug before cleaning, or mention dock placement on carpet, the robot-side contacts, or when to contact iRobot. The closing reply, 'Good news, that has sorted it', was a bit overconfident after only 4 nights, but it was reasonable to tell the customer to repeat the same check if the fault returns.
